Washington State Cop Pulls Over A Woman For Drunk Driving And...Well...She Was Missing Something
1 hr ago
Audio By Carbonatix
A Washington state police officer made a traffic stop in December and found the driver naked.
Her excuse? She doesn’t actually know. Shes coming back from “dancing.”
She admitted to consuming alcohol but didn’t remember how much.
The dancer also admitted to consuming 10 mg of marijuana.
Changing clothes + intoxicated + driving 70 mph = DUI.
The woman complained about the sobriety tests, calling them “unfair” since the officer didn’t have to perform them naked with her.
